problem: Farrell–Jones conjecture on whether certain assembly maps are isomorphisms; Bost conjecture: a specific case of the Farrell–Jones conjecture
missing_details: Discrete group G for which the assembly map is defined
Ring R whose group ring R[G] appears as the target
Family of virtually cyclic subgroups VCYC(G) determining the source space
Definition of the classifying space E_{VCYC}(G) as a G–CW–complex with virtually cyclic isotropy
Equivariant homology theories KR_*^G and LR_*^G satisfying KR_n^G(*)≅K_n(R[G]) and LR_n^G(*)≅L_n(R[G])
Projection map p: E_{VCYC}(G)→* whose induced map on homology is the assembly map
Statement that the map is required to be an isomorphism in all degrees n
For the Bost conjecture: family FIN(G) of finite subgroups and its classifying space E_{FIN}(G)
Equivariant homology theory K_{l^1}^{top} with H_*^G(*;K_{l^1}^{top})=K_*(l^1(G))
Specification that the assembly map H_*^G(E_{FIN}(G);K_{l^1}^{top})→K_*(l^1(G)) is to be an isomorphism for all degrees
refined_question: Let G be a discrete group and R a unital ring. 1) Let VCYC(G) denote the family of virtually cyclic subgroups of G and let E_{VCYC}(G) be a G–CW–complex characterized by having isotropy in VCYC(G) and contractible fixed points for each H∈VCYC(G).  Let KR_*^G(–) and LR_*^G(–) be equivariant homology theories with KR_n^G(*)≅K_n(R[G]) and LR_n^G(*)≅L_n(R[G]).  Does the projection p:E_{VCYC}(G)→* induce isomorphisms KR_*^G(E_{VCYC}(G))→K_*(R[G]) and LR_*^G(E_{VCYC}(G))→L_*(R[G]) in all degrees?  2) (Bost conjecture)  Let FIN(G) be the family of finite subgroups of G and E_{FIN}(G) its classifying space.  Let K_{l^1}^{top} be the equivariant homology theory associated to the Banach algebra l^1(G), so that H_*^G(*;K_{l^1}^{top})=K_*(l^1(G)).  Does the assembly map H_*^G(E_{FIN}(G);K_{l^1}^{top})→K_*(l^1(G)) induce an isomorphism in all degrees?
justification: The name mentions only ‘certain assembly maps’ and their being isomorphisms, but omits all specifying data: the group G, the ring R, the family of virtually cyclic subgroups VCYC(G), the G–CW–complex E_{VCYC}(G), and the equivariant homology theories whose evaluation on a point recovers K_n(R[G]) or L_n(R[G]).  The Bost conjecture further specializes to the family FIN(G), the Banach algebra l^1(G), and the corresponding equivariant homology theory K_{l^1}^{top}.  Making these elements explicit yields a fully self–contained statement.
